email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Alumni Relations & Community Coordinator role at the British School of Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, community engagement, and event coordination, I am drawn to BSB's commitment to fostering a vibrant, inclusive alumni community.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage communications and content for client websites, including building and maintaining a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles. This experience has honed my ability to manage data, create engaging content, and coordinate digital engagement initiatives. Previously, as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I supported the development of digital workplace sites for large organizations, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver projects.

I am a proactive relationship-builder with strong organisational skills and a natural curiosity about people. I thrive in roles that connect individuals and create memorable experiences. I am eager to bring my skills in communications, data management, and community building to BSB and contribute to a thriving alumni programme.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Alumni Relations & Community Coordinator position at the British School of Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, community engagement, and event coordination, I am inspired by BSB's dedication to building a lifelong connection among alumni, students, and staff. I am confident that my skills in communications, data management, and relationship-building align well with the responsibilities of this role.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO content and communications for client websites, including building and maintaining a pharmacists' association site with approximately 600 member profiles. This experience has strengthened my ability to manage data accurately, create engaging content across multiple channels, and coordinate digital engagement initiatives. I have also collaborated with team members to deliver projects on time, ensuring high-quality outcomes. Previously, as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I supported the development of SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for large organisations, working closely with colleagues to facilitate effective communication and engagement.

Beyond technical skills, I am a proactive and warm relationship-builder who enjoys connecting people from diverse backgrounds. I am highly organised, capable of managing multiple priorities, and comfortable working independently. My experience with CRM-like systems and data reporting has equipped me to maintain accurate records and derive insights to improve engagement. I am also culturally intelligent and discreet, with a natural curiosity about people and a commitment to inclusive community building.

I am eager to bring my skills to BSB and contribute to the growth of a vibrant alumni programme. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support BSB's alumni relations goals.

Warm regards,
